name: Quiet Mantle
description: Wear a mantle of absolute quiet that takes the force from each blow and the heart from each striker.

name: Seeping Cessation
description: Let cessation seep out of the user until every foe near enough finds each function failing in turn.

name: Cessation Lance
description: Drive a lance of pure cessation through guard and flesh and into the vital line beyond.

name: Passing Remission
description: Let the ending of a deep curse pass gently through an ally and leave the body clear.

name: Perishing Tide
description: Send a tide of perishing qi across the field that strips life from all it reaches.

name: Dust Age
description: Pass a thousand years of wear through gear and flesh in a ring and leave only dust.

name: Doom Reckoning
description: Call the final reckoning down on a single foe and take life that no ward can hold.

name: Elder Release
description: Draw the burden of long years and a lasting death-curse out of many allies at once.

name: Cessation Hand
description: The school's laid hand of cessation that stops a foe's strength by the weight of qi behind it.

name: Declared End
description: The school's declaration of an ending that falls on one foe as heavily as the master's core allows.

name: Withering Crown
description: The school's crown of wither raised over the field with a reach that follows the qi given.

name: Great Cessation
description: Bring a great cessation down on a wide region up to the destructive ceiling of a Core-tier death master.

name: Inevitable Thread
description: Mark one being so that the world leans toward its ending along a thread; no cultivation mechanic explains why events arrange themselves around that end.
